transforms.code: return [{'label': n, 'value': n} for n in (value or [])]

config.script:
d = self.session.custom.recipeDraft
	vals = cal1615.recipes.get(d.name)
	for k in cal1615.recipes.KEYS:
		d.values[k] = vals.get(k, 0)

d = self.session.custom.recipeDraft
	vals = cal1615.recipes.readActive()
	for k in cal1615.recipes.KEYS:
		d.values[k] = vals.get(k, 0)

name = self.view.custom.newName.strip()
	d = self.session.custom.recipeDraft
	cal1615.recipes.save(name, cal1615.recipes.fromDraft(d.values))
	d.name = name
	self.view.custom.newName = ''
